description: This file is a PHP web page that includes headers, navigation, and scripts to display call signal logs in a web interface. It contains PHP code for including other files, some JavaScript for fetching data via AJAX, and HTML for layout.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Initializes page elements and triggers AJAX call to load call signal logs.

methods.name: on load
methods.description: Handles window load event to setup AJAX call and process results.
